summary.text: Racers from Amonkhet, Avishkar and Muraganda race across planes in the Ghirapur Grand Prix, whose winner claims the Aetherspark, and Chandra Nalaar enters to put a smile on Nissa's face.
Chandra, her mother Pia and Sita, who races masked as Spitfire, are drawn into a fight against Jace and Vraska, who take Loot, while Sita's father Mohar plots a coup to restore the old order.
The Amonkheti team of Zahur and Basri crosses the finish line first, and the Champions receive the Aetherspark together as a team.
